[SWS_CM_02203] Service versioning is not checked at runtime in case of a static
service connection
⌈
Service versions are not checked at run-time in case of a static
service connection since the Service Discovery has been bypassed.
⌋
Note:
ara::com language APIs are agnostic to static service connection.
